LESSON: EARLY CIVILISATION ● ASIA, ● EUROPE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.2: Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is cultural heritage important to society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast
2. show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world
3. appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: EARLY CIVILISATION ● ASIA, ● EUROPE
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: EARLY CIVILISATION ● ASIA, ● EUROPE
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast

What this means
In this part you learn to describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world

What this means
In this part you learn to show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Participate: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Connect “Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe. (skill: show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world)

Example 3: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take. (skill: appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast.
3. Practise this skill: show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is cultural heritage important to society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast.
5. Be able to: show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
